question: How did God answer Moses' request to enter the promised land?
options: God allowed him to enter with Joshua
God told him to wait one more year
God gave him the land east of the Jordan instead
God said Moses could only view the land from a mountain but not cross over
explanation: God would not let Moses cross the Jordan but told him to go up Pisgah and look at the land in every direction, since Joshua would lead the people in.
